messages:
Maria (Partnerships): Heads-up — partner portal (ACMECloud) is rejecting bundled-SKU POs; procurement routing to marketplace ledger is failing. Seen in staging and one early prod try. Need a short-term workaround.

Josh (Marketplace): Can you paste the gateway error? Is this the nested-bundle flag or SKU alias mapping?

Maria (Partnerships): Error snippet from the portal: ```ERROR 422: bundle_line_items rejected: field 'line_item.sku' invalid or missing; accepted format: flat_line_items[]```

Josh (Marketplace): Ugh, this is the portal enforcing flat line items — ACME's bundle uses parent-child SKUs. Two options: 1) split bundle into discrete lines (same PO#, multiple SKUs) so ledger accepts it, or 2) partner adds a parent-SKU alias on their marketplace listing.

Tara (Finance): Splitting is a non-starter for some customers — tax/tariff reporting expects a single bundle line for that product family. If we split, reconciliation headaches and possible re-billing.

Ben (Legal): We can do an addendum to accept split-lines for specific customers but need partner sign-off and 10 business days to get paperwork in place.

Josh (Marketplace): Technical note: we can hotfix the marketplace connector to translate parent->child server-side for staging in ~48h. Prod rollout would need procurement sign-off for fallback rules.

Maria (Partnerships): @tessa / procurement — can you greenlight temporary routing rules if we implement server-side translation? We need cover for tax/reconciliation concerns. :pray:

ProcureBot: PO routing job failed — job_id=po-route-4821, reason=invalid_line_item_shape, retries=2. Link: https://procure.internal/jobs/po-route-4821

Tara (Finance): If we do server-side translation, we need a reconciliation report exported with original bundle metadata attached to the PO to satisfy auditors. Acceptable if connector emits `bundle_metadata` field on each translated line.

Josh (Marketplace): OK — we can include bundle_metadata (parent_sku, bundle_quantity, original_total) in the translated lines. Will prototype in staging and post the patch link.

Maria (Partnerships): Good. Plan for now: (1) Josh to prototype staging translation and attach bundle_metadata (2) Tara: confirm finance acceptance of attached metadata format (3) Ben: legal to draft a short acceptance note for partner to sign if needed. If any blocker by EOD we'll escalate to execs.

Josh (Marketplace): I'll drop a PR + staging run by 2398767900 and ping this thread when done.

Tara (Finance): If staging passes, finance can approve temporary acceptance with a condition: partner must provide a monthly reconciliation CSV by the first business day after month-end.

Ben (Legal): Noted. I'll prepare a simple acceptance template.

Maria (Partnerships): Thanks — looping in partner success to notify ACMECloud. Will update channel after staging test. :white_check_mark:
